en: A monochrome blue-toned image showing a small historic watermill house beside a calm river or canal. The building has whitewashed or light-colored masonry walls and a steep, tiled gabled roof. A wooden water wheel is attached to the side, next to a simple timber sluice or weir structure over the water. Dense trees form a backdrop, and the mill and foliage are reflected clearly in the water. The image is bordered by a white margin, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No printed text is visible on the front.
